s3.shape-descriptorscurated\begin{aligned}\term{compactness}{C}&=\dfrac{4\pi\term{area}{A}}{\term{perimeter}{P}^2},\quad\term{schwartzberg}{S}=\sqrt{\term{compactness}{C}},\quad\term{convexity}{V}=\min\left(\dfrac{\term{area}{A}}{\term{hull-area}{H}},1\right)\\\term{elongation}{E}&=1-\sqrt{\dfrac{\term{minor}{\lambda_2}}{\term{major}{\lambda_1}}},\quad\term{sliver}{F}=\mathbb{1}\left[\term{perimeter}{P}>0\land(\term{area}{A}\le0\lor\term{compactness}{C}<\term{threshold}{\tau})\right]\end{aligned}Polsby-Popper C=4*pi*A/P^2; Schwartzberg S=sqrt(C); convexity V=min(A/H,1) for hull area H; elongation E=1-sqrt(lambda2/lambda1) with lambda2=max(mean-radius,0), lambda1=mean+radius from central moments. Sliver is P>0 and (A<=0 or C<threshold). C and S are NaN unless A>0 and P>0, V is NaN without positive hull area, E is NaN without a positive major eigenvalue.
